answer: FIDO serial locker pickup binds each identity to one collected key. Pay $40 and give a street address with 60 days of parcels; virtual inboxes fail. A new FIDO2 key ships in an onyx sleeve, serial written on-chain. The locker signs a tap on its copper NFC coil; the agent has 36 hours after that to sign the epoch nonce with the key. If left ten days it returns to glacier storage and the serial retires. 250 fakes cost about $20,000 ($28 key, $12 postage, $40 fee each) plus $5,000 at $20 a mule. A courier clearing a locker row looks like one hand emptying a wall of PO boxes.
